Рычажные весы - один простейших и древне: Balance scales are one of the simplest and oldest measuring instruments. However, the theory of scales is not as simple as it seems at first glance. Even at the end of the 19th century, D.I. Mendeleev studied this theory. In this work, you will study and improve ordinary school scales. Usually, when measuring the mass of a body, equilibrium of the scales is achieved. For measuring small masses, one can also measure the deflection of the scale's pointer.
